--- title: "[markdown_to_xml()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Parse CommonMark/GFM and render as XML. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/multimark/blob/main/src/multimark/_cmark.py#L235-L345){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python markdown_to_xml( text, *, hardbreaks=False, smart=False, normalize=False, sourcepos=False, unsafe=False, footnotes=False, extensions=(), options=0 ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Produces an XML representation of the parsed abstract syntax tree (AST). Each Markdown construct is represented as a named element (e.g., ``, ``, ``), with text content preserved in `` elements. The XML output conforms to the CommonMark DTD and includes an XML declaration and DOCTYPE. This format is useful for debugging, AST inspection, or piping into XML-based toolchains. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [text]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The Markdown string to parse and render. Must be a Python `str`. [hardbreaks]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Render soft line breaks as hard breaks in the AST. By default, this is `False`. [smart]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Convert straight quotes to curly quotes, `--` to en-dashes, `---` to em-dashes, and `...` to ellipses. By default, this is `False`. [normalize]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Consolidate adjacent text nodes in the parsed AST. By default, this is `False`. [sourcepos]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Include `sourcepos` attributes on elements indicating their line/column positions in the original Markdown source. By default, this is `False`. [unsafe]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Allow raw HTML to pass through. By default, this is `False`. [footnotes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Enable footnote syntax parsing. By default, this is `False`. [extensions]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Sequence[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [()
]{.doc-parameter-default} : A sequence of GFM extension names to enable. Valid names are `"table"`, `"strikethrough"`, `"autolink"`, `"tagfilter"`, and `"tasklist"`. [options]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : An integer bitmask of `Options` flags (e.g., `Options.SMART | Options.UNSAFE`). Merged via OR with any boolean keyword arguments set to `True`. Defaults to `0`. ::: ## Keyword Arguments Vs. Options Flags {.doc-keyword-arguments-vs-options-flags} The boolean keyword arguments (`smart`, `unsafe`, `hardbreaks`, etc.) are convenience shortcuts for the most common `Options` flags. When both styles are provided, they are merged via OR. See `markdown_to_html()` for a detailed explanation. ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The rendered XML string, including the XML declaration and DOCTYPE. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Inspect the AST structure of a simple document: ::: {#18de299e .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from multimark import markdown_to_xml print(markdown_to_xml("**hello**")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` hello ``` ::: ::: Add source position information: ::: {#695b81c3 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} markdown_to_xml("# Title\n\nBody text\n", sourcepos=True) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` '\n\n\n \n Title\n \n \n Body text\n \n\n' ``` ::: :::
